simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to חֹלֶד (H2467) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.

simple.summary: חֹלֶד (chôled) means a weasel (from its gliding motion) First listed occurrence: Lev 11 29.

definitions.full: H2467. choled חֹ֫לֶד noun [masculine] weasel (Late Hebrew חוּלְדָּא ; Arabic mole or blind-rat , or a species of rat ; on formative see Lag BN 144 ) — weasel Lev 11:29 (Vrss Ki Thes and others see especially Di; > Saad Bo MV SS Lag l.c. mole ).
